new_all_degree_arguments: A pure positive regular graph measure has Cauchy transform1/s on the exterior;an edge bordering that exterior on both sides has zero jump and is impossible. Interior bridges are not excluded.
Mergelyan approximation,Jordan boundary extension and Fourier uniqueness make every full-support positive pure Jordan measure the harmonic measure at0,with0 in the bounded domain.

The extremum ball lower bound epsilon^(N/2) and harmonic corner upper bound epsilon^(k*beta) force opening>=2*pi*k/N. The abstract cubic loop therefore has no C2 compact real-seed realization in dimensions1,2,3.
On the sphere,all interior seed bands are O(epsilon),including at critical polynomial parameters via the Beurling bound;hence no interior degenerate critical point or saddle survives.

The universal O(sqrt(epsilon)) endpoint bound,rank1 analytic splitting,and quartic Fatou rescaling force every nonisolated endpoint component to be a smooth critical circle with nondegenerate normal Hessian.

Critical circles have total gradient index0;isolated extrema have index+1. Poincare-Hopf leaves exactly two isolated critical points. Their invariant pair forces a cyclic or dihedral rotation group,excluding O and I even at outward cusps.

Normalized p and bar(p) recover the real parameter rationally,giving generic injectivity. A Jordan image is therefore traversed once. All simple Jordan images are excluded for full original T-invariant thin pure phases in every degree.
